en: Black‑and‑white view of a busy European city street crossing or small square, lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings in historicist style. The prominent corner building on the left carries large rooftop lettering reading "GLASPALAST." and a sign "KLEIDER SALON." Below are shopfronts and trees in front of the façades, with pedestrians in period clothing and a small streetcar or omnibus on the central street. Another building to the right has many open windows and balconies. The scene suggests an early‑20th‑century urban commercial district.
